queryPatterns: exact season manufacturer product checklist PDF
exact season manufacturer product checklist XLSX CSV

policy.scope: Every known missing mainstream sports set from 2000 through the current year, every known pre-2000 sports set identity without checklist rows, and broad vintage discovery for set identities not yet in the master catalog.
policy.communitySources: Reddit, Blowout Forums, TCDB, and shared spreadsheets are discovery leads only until provenance and redistribution permission are confirmed.
policy.dedupe: Exact set keys are unique. Recovered files are SHA-256 hashed and source items are deduplicated before catalog merge.
policy.downloadRule: Automatically download only public, permitted, exact-set checklist files or factual tables from trusted sources. Never bypass logins, paywalls, CAPTCHAs, robots restrictions, or access controls.
policy.completeness: The Sentinel searches both known gaps and broad year-, decade-, manufacturer-, and sport-based discovery queries so new or previously unknown checklist identities can enter the review queue.
policy.freezeProtection: Write atomic progress and checkpoint files every five minutes, save on termination signals, restore cached state, detect stale progress, and resume unfinished targets without duplicating completed work.
